comando: actual=$(snmpwalk -v2c -c public {ip} 1.3.6.1.2.1.43.11.1.1.9 | sed -n 's/.*INTEGER: \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); maximo=$(snmpwalk -v2c -c public {ip} 1.3.6.1.2.1.43.11.1.1.8 | sed -n 's/.*INTEGER: \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); mac=$(snmpwalk -v2c -c public {ip} 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.6 | awk '/\.1 = Hex-STRING:/ {for(i=4;i<=NF;i++) printf "%s%s",(i==4?"":":"),$i; exit}'); sn=$(snmpwalk -v2c -c public {ip} 1.3.6.1.2.1.43.5.1.1.17 | sed -n 's/.*STRING: "\(.*\)"/\1/p' | head -n1); [ -n "$actual" ] && [ -n "$maximo" ] && [ "$maximo" -gt 0 ] || exit 1; porcentaje=$(awk -v actual="$actual" -v maximo="$maximo" 'BEGIN { printf "%.0f", actual * 100 / maximo }'); printf '{"toner":{"Black":%s},"paginas":{},"mac":"%s","sn":"%s"}' "$porcentaje" "$mac" "$sn"
